svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The pre-push review gate
svg.desc: How a push is now decided: the moon task runs the review, the CLI turns the verdict and kept findings into a base code, and the journal-state budget decides whether that code stops the push.

g.text: PRE-PUSH HOOK · MOON TASK IN THE BUILDER'S WORKS…
